title: Defeater disposition is itself proof-carrying
problem: An uncertainty system can be gamed by relabeling an OPEN defeater as RESOLVED or RESIDUAL without evidence.
rules: The resolution_witness_id must exist in the usable witness registry.
RESIDUAL requires an explicit rationale note and remains visible in assurance warnings.
OPEN defeaters targeting a required role downgrade terminal PASS to UNKNOWN and block empirical authority.
invariants: Closing a challenge requires support, not a status edit
Accepted residual doubt must remain inspectable
boundary: A usable resolution witness can still be scientifically wrong; HF-SIM-013 witness obligations and HF-SIM-017 support-graph rules remain applicable.
